svg.title: MediaLog
svg.desc: A demoscene banner, chrome spheres over a checkerboard, for MediaLog. MEDIALOG floats in a sunset sky as a thick italic chrome logo beside a chrome open book with a play triangle and a pen, steel blue with a bright break line and two engraved grooves across its lower half. Small type above it says A MEDIA DIARY YOU SHARE. Under it a line reads EVERYTHING YOU'VE, then a hexagonal chrome drum, then ON ONE TIMELINE; the drum turns to WATCHED, READ, PLAYED or LISTENED TO, each face in a kind's colour. Below, a navy and pale grey checker floor runs away from the viewer into the haze at a low horizon, and six mirror balls ride a carousel over it, bouncing in a wave: red for films, blue for shows, amber for books, green for games, teal for albums, violet for podcasts. Whichever sphere is at the front, the drum shows its verb. Far off in the haze on the left, one pale, blurred sphere drifts back and forth over a label that says SOMETIME IN 2015-2019. The sky runs a one-minute day: sunset in plum, violet, magenta, red and amber, a starry navy night with a crescent moon and coloured light under the spheres, a teal and green dawn, a blue day. A slow scroller at the horizon, in the kind colours, gives the pitch: log a film, a book, a show, a game, an album or a podcast, when and how it was, then see what the people you know have been into; a log five years at a time; and a few made-up feed posts.
